title: Adaptive Synthetic Data Augmentation Toolkit
summary: A Streamlit-based framework built during an ITSOLERA internship project that identifies poorly-performing classes in an imbalanced classification model and generates targeted synthetic samples to augment training data, then retrains and re-evaluates the model. It uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer and Condition-based sampling to generate synthetic data, with quality assessed via SDV's evaluate_quality report.
evidence: Project 4/app.py:73-75 'synthesizer = TVAESynthesizer(metadata)'; notebook uses sdv.sampling.Condition and evaluate_quality
